I pulled the requested artifacts and ran a quick alignment against our control-plane events. Summary below — sending raw_trace excerpt as an attachment (raw_traces_usw2_0529.log) and a short CSV of request counts:

Preliminary findings:
- Spike onset: 2026-05-29T15:56:40Z (08:56:40 PDT) coincident with a mesh reconfiguration event on pod set infra-usw2-azb.
- Peak error ratio: 22% of requests to /v1/generate from 15:58:00Z–16:03:30Z.
- Recovery to baseline (<=1% errors): 2026-05-29T16:15:28Z (09:15:28 PDT).
- Root cause signal: rapid eviction of several worker containers during an autoscaler recalibration; fallback routing succeeded but introduced retry amplification on a small subset of tenant routes.

Conservative eligible window per our SLA computation rules: 2026-05-29T15:56:00Z — 2026-05-29T16:15:30Z (19m 30s). I attach the raw traces and a proposed remediation allocation matrix (draft_remedy_allocation_matrix.xlsx) which applies the contractual 99.9% monthly availability baseline and prorata formula from clause 4.2.

Attachments: raw_traces_usw2_0529.log (text, 18MB); draft_remedy_allocation_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Notes for Irene/Vanessa: the window begins shortly before your reported timestamp; the estimated impacted token volume for BlueHarbor's tenant id BH-2023-019 is small but non-trivial. Recommend confirming with BlueHarbor whether they want a credit memo or a one-time invoice adjustment.

- David
